reading.summary: This page lists a set of courses from Hugging Face. The courses cover large language models, agents, diffusion models, computer vision, audio, reinforcement learning, robotics, game development, and 3D machine learning. The page also includes a collection of open-source-powered notebooks by AI builders, for AI builders.
